title: Nontrivial Markov Type Forces Superreflexivity
summary: We prove that every real Banach space with Markov type p > 1 is superreflexive. Together with the known converse, this characterizes superreflexivity by nontrivial Markov type. This answers Naor's question: every real Banach space with nontrivial Markov type admits an equivalent uniformly smooth norm.

review.reason: Proves that nontrivial Markov type implies superreflexivity for real Banach spaces.
